papers.title: Expensive control of long-time averages using sum of squares and its application to a laminar wake flow
papers.abstract: The paper presents a nonlinear state-feedback control design approach for long-time average cost control, where the control effort is assumed to be expensive. The approach is based on sum-of-squares and semi-definite programming techniques. It is applicable to dynamical systems whose right-hand side is a polynomial function in the state variables and the controls. The key idea, first described but not implemented in (Chernyshenko et al., Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A, 372, 2014), is that the difficult problem of optimizing a cost function involving long-time averages is replaced by an optimization of the upper bound of the same average. As such, controller design requires the simultaneous optimization of both the control law and a tunable function, similar to a Lyapunov function. The present paper introduces a method resolving the well-known inherent non-convexity of this kind of optimization. The method is based on the formal assumption that the control is expensive, from which it follows that the optimal control is small. The resulting asymptotic optimization problems are convex. The derivation of all the polynomial coefficients in the controller is given in terms of the solvability conditions of state-dependent linear and bilinear inequalities. The proposed approach is applied to the problem of designing a full-information feedback controller that mitigates vortex shedding in the wake of a circular cylinder in the laminar regime via rotary oscillations. Control results on a reduced-order model of the actuated wake and in direct numerical simulation are reported.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究基于平方和与半定规划的长时间平均控制，应用于层流尾流，与有限元代理模型或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses control of fluid flows using sum-of-squares optimization, with no FEA surrogate modeling, no uncertainty quantification, no constraints handling, and no transferability to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对长时间平均成本控制中优化困难的问题，提出基于平方和的方法

summary_en.motivation: To address the difficulty of optimizing long-time average cost control, a sum-of-squares based approach is proposed.
summary_en.method: The non-convex optimization is transformed into convex optimization by assuming expensive control, jointly optimizing the control law and a tunable function.
summary_en.result: The method is validated on a reduced-order model and direct numerical simulation for vortex shedding mitigation in a cylinder wake.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via reduced-order model and direct numerical simulation.

papers.title: Decreased femoral periprosthetic bone mineral density: a comparative study using DXA in patients after cementless total hip arthroplasty with osteonecrosis of the femoral head versus primary osteoarthritis

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅通过DXA比较不同病因患者术后股骨骨密度变化，未涉及有限元分析、应力遮挡或微动等生物力学建模。
llm.why_not_core: No finite element modeling, no quantification of stress/strain/micromotion, no comparison of intact vs implanted femur, and no boundary conditions for implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较股骨头坏死与原发性骨关节炎患者全髋置换术后股骨假体周围骨密度变化。
summary_zh.method: 采用双能X线吸收测定法(DXA)对两组患者术后进行骨密度测量。
summary_zh.result: 股骨头坏死组在部分Gruen区域骨密度下降更显著。

summary_en.motivation: To compare periprosthetic bone mineral density loss after cementless total hip arthroplasty between patients with osteonecrosis of the femoral head and those with primary osteoarthritis.
summary_en.method: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) was used to measure bone mineral density in Gruen zones postoperatively.
summary_en.result: The osteonecrosis group showed greater bone mineral density loss in certain Gruen zones.
summary_en.validation: Clinical DXA measurements with inter-group comparison.
